name: Supine Hip Internal Rotation Stretch

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: Cornell Health Lower Extremity Range of Motion Protocol

steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, placed slightly wider than hip-width apart.
Keeping your left knee pointing up, slowly let your right knee drop inward toward the floor and toward your left ankle.
Keep both shoulder blades and your lower back resting comfortably on the mat.
Feel a gentle stretch in the outer hip and front of your right hip joint.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds, return the right knee upright, and repeat with the left leg.
coaching_cues: Do not force your knee to touch the floor; allow gravity to create a gentle, comfortable stretch.
If you experience sharp pinching inside the hip joint, stop the stretch immediately.

sources.attribution: Cornell Health Lower Extremity Range of Motion Protocol
